title: Decide when the breaker should open
description: Change traffic, failures, slow calls, and the measurement window. The lab opens only when enough evidence exists and a declared boundary is crossed.
modelNotice: This deterministic teaching model applies the configured rates to one measurement window. Production libraries aggregate actual outcomes with concurrency-safe sliding windows.

scenarios.label: Healthy dependency
scenarios.detail: Rare failures and a small slow tail.

scenarios.label: Slow brownout
scenarios.detail: Most calls eventually work, but waiting consumes caller capacity.

scenarios.label: Hard outage
scenarios.detail: Connection failures make continued calls unlikely to succeed.

scenarios.label: Low-volume fluke
scenarios.detail: Every call fails, but the sample is too small to control the path.
